acceptanceCriteria: Workers launched before the drain can read the signal.
A claim during the drain is refused or returns the notice.
The signal disappears when the drain is lifted.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1043 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem When a service drain starts, live workers do not know. They keep starting long commands and hold up the drain. Current workaround Tools the agent calls constantly print a warning on stderr while a stop file exists, and a context-budget tool answers 'hand off now' in drain mode. Proposal While desired is DRAINING, expose a documented signal to workers (a file path named in their environment, plus a short notice appended to `corvint-tasks` output) telling them to finish current work, release and end. Share the mechanism with the context-size notice in #1007. See beamfall/corvint#1043 for the full text.
title: dispatch: tell live workers that a drain is pending (issue #1043)
